title: Make the CSS contract tests independent of the vitest working directory
outcome: From /review-changes round 3 (Claude, delegation 46004bcb; gate test-171aa649) on the corrected UI/Test Runs changeset. Note, and seen first-hand: ui/src/test-run-waits.test.tsx:82 and ui/src/panels/SessionActivityStrip.test.tsx:68 build CSS file paths from process.cwd() (assuming cwd = ui/), and load node:fs through a variable module name. A focused run with vitest --root ui from the repo root (run test-ea04b73d, 2026-09-26) failed both with ENOENT. The gate runs from ui/, so it passes there. Resolve the path from import.meta.url, as transcript-activity-slot.test.tsx already does, or use Vite's ?raw CSS import, so these tests don't depend on the runner's cwd.
